hero.title: About IDLOGICE
hero.subtitle: Expert Canadian immigration consultants based in Montreal. 10+ years of experience. 95% success rate. Serving clients from over 50 countries.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Since 2014, IDLOGICE has been helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate the Canadian immigration system. Based in Montreal at 410 Saint-Catherine Street, our team of Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs) provides expert, personalized guidance across all immigration pathways — from Express Entry and Provincial Nominee Programs to work permits, study permits, family sponsorships, and citizenship applications. We believe that every person deserves access to clear, honest immigration advice. Our 95% success rate reflects our commitment to doing things right the first time.

items.title: Accuracy First
items.description: Our CRS calculator uses the official IRCC scoring matrix, updated whenever rules change. Every calculation is versioned and traceable.

items.title: Your Data Is Private
items.description: We collect only what we need to run your evaluation. We never sell data to third parties or share it with immigration consultants without your explicit consent.

items.title: Education Over Sales
items.description: Our goal is to help you make informed decisions — not to push you into purchasing a service you may not need. Free tools stay free.

cta.title: Ready to Start?
cta.subtitle: Check your CRS score and eligibility in under 5 minutes — completely free.
